QuestInfo.name: A Truth So Cruel
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Unidentified Assailant and find out what's going on.\n#bClick on the tent where the Unidentified Assailant is.
QuestInfo.1: You were attacked by unidentified assailants while examining the tent. They seem to have some connection with your parents. Defeat them and gather clues.
QuestInfo.2: You investigated, but it didn't help. They called Chromile a coward... Could that be true?
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?

1.0: Argh... You can't get anywhere with just these clues...
1.1: F-father! Is what he said true?! You were supposed to be a good person! You were supposed to be the Knight of Light!
